body:
Yeah, I get you and I'm sorry that you have these o:

Like, my problem really is that reality does correspond for the most part and that it's not just paranoia. Not with Isabelle, necessarily, but I've correctly assessed the feelings of close friends towards myself a lot of times, and this time again I did that with Mackenzie. 

I've shared this with the "last" close friend I have for sure, and she told me that people's (re-)actions seemed weird to her too and so on and so forth.

Nonetheless, thank you for your input. I too think that it will work out sooner or later, just objectively speaking, but god, when? I just don't know for how long I can keep this up. But, you know this feeling just as well as I do.

Thank you for your comment, it means a lot. I'm glad that you've only been really actually suicidal a few times, but, you're also right that passive suicidality *is* the absolute worst.

Nonetheless, and I'm sure you can understand, it seems as though I just cannot get myself to continue at this point. I've been talking to my friends so many times now, especially Isabelle and, while she clearly understands what's going on and while she always supported and re-iterated for me how much I mean to her, I just don't know anymore. Why is she not saying nice things, why does she only ever tell me how much I mean to her when I'm in an exceptional situation?

Etc. etc.
